text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Mircera overdosage can elevate hemoglobin levels above the desired level, which should be managed with discontinuation or reduction of Mircera dosage and/or with phlebotomy, as clinically indicated [see Pharmacodynamics (12.2) ]. Cases of severe hypertension have been observed following overdose with ESAs [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ].
